```{r, read-input, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# SKRIP SKENARIO 2: PROYEKSI MULTI-INDIKATOR MAKROEKONOMI
# Spesifikasi: Tutupan Lahan BAU + Target Laju Pertumbuhan Baru (Policy Growth)
# Kerangka Teoritis: Supply-Constrained Mixed IO (Hubacek & Sun, 2001)
# ==============================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PERSIAPAN & SANITASI DATA BASELINE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
descriptive_analysis_file <- "inst/extdata/output/descriptive_analysis_module.rds"
projection_area_file_bau <- "inst/extdata/scenario/scenarioBAU/luc_projection.xlsx"

initial_year <- params$initial_year

baseline <- load_projection_baseline(
  path = descriptive_analysis_file,
  projection_area_file_bau = projection_area_file_bau
)

# Akses komponen baseline
gdp_baseline      <- baseline$gdp_baseline
leontief_matrix   <- baseline$leontief_matrix
full_io_table     <- baseline$full_io_table
code_registry     <- baseline$code_registry
sector_idx        <- baseline$sector_idx
intermediate_consumption.m <- baseline$intermediate_consumption
income_multiplier <- baseline$income_multiplier
labour_multiplier <- baseline$labour_multiplier
SUB_multiplier    <- baseline$SUB_multiplier
output_multiplier <- baseline$output_multiplier
linkage_table     <- baseline$linkage_table
P_default         <- baseline$P_default
growth_rate       <- baseline$growth_rate
area_matrix_bau   <- baseline$area_matrix_bau
constrained       <- baseline$constrained
unconstrained     <- baseline$unconstrained

scenario_inputs <- list(
    name              = paste0("Skenario_", params$scenario_name),
    luc_projection    = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario2/luc_projection.xlsx",
    land_distribution = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario2/luc_projection.xlsx",
    lpc               = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario2/produktivitas_lpc.xlsx",
    io_changes        = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario2/perubahan_io.xlsx"
  )

sc_input <- load_scenario_inputs(scenario_inputs, P_default)

# 1.2 Ekstraksi Vektor Sektoral Utuh
sektor_names <- as.character(unlist(gdp_baseline$SECTOR))
Y_0 <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$FD)); names(Y_0) <- sektor_names
x_0 <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$OUTPUT)); names(x_0) <- sektor_names
v_0 <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$GDP)); names(v_0) <- sektor_names
Land_0 <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$Land_Requirement))
LPC_0 <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$LPC))

# Matriks Transaksi Antara (Z)
Z <- as.matrix(baseline$intermediate_consumption)
storage.mode(Z) <- "numeric"
rownames(Z) <- colnames(Z) <- sektor_names

# 1.3 Filtering Sektor Valid (Hanya Sektor dengan Output Baseline > 0)
idx_valid <- which(x_0 > 0)
Z <- Z[idx_valid, idx_valid, drop = FALSE]
x_0 <- x_0[idx_valid]
Y_0 <- Y_0[idx_valid]
v_0 <- v_0[idx_valid]
Land_0 <- Land_0[idx_valid]
LPC_0 <- LPC_0[idx_valid]
sektor_names <- sektor_names[idx_valid]
n <- length(idx_valid)

# 1.4 EKSTRAKSI KOEFISIEN INPUT PRIMER LANGSUNG (KOREKSI REAL VALUE)
# A. Koefisien PDRB / GDP
v_c <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$GDP_PROP))[idx_valid]

# B. Koefisien Pendapatan Tenaga Kerja Langsung (w_c)
w_c <- as.numeric(unlist(baseline$labour_multiplier$Labour_Compensation))[idx_valid] / x_0

# C. Koefisien Serapan Tenaga Kerja Langsung (l_c) -> Satuan: Orang / Juta Rp
l_c <- as.numeric(unlist(baseline$labour_multiplier$Labour))[idx_valid] / x_0

# D. Koefisien Surplus Usaha Bruto Langsung (sub_c)
sub_c <- as.numeric(unlist(baseline$SUB_multiplier$Surplus))[idx_valid] / x_0

# 1.5 Mapping Indeks Sektor Terkendala (co) dan Bebas (nc)
constrained <- baseline$constrained
unconstrained <- baseline$unconstrained
co_idx <- which(idx_valid %in% which(constrained == 1))
no_idx <- which(idx_valid %in% which(unconstrained == 1))

# 1.6 Reklasifikasi Sektor Bermasalah (Land_0 = 0 atau LPC_0 = 0 dipindahkan ke nc)
mask_bermasalah <- (Land_0[co_idx] <= 0) | (LPC_0[co_idx] <= 0)
if (any(mask_bermasalah)) {
  co_idx_pindah <- co_idx[mask_bermasalah]
  co_idx <- co_idx[!mask_bermasalah]
  no_idx <- sort(c(no_idx, co_idx_pindah))
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FORMULASI SUB-MATRIKS MIXED INPUT-OUTPUT
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1 Matriks Koefisien Teknis (A) dan Matriks Leontief (M = I - A)
A_full <- sweep(Z, 2, x_0, "/")
M_full <- diag(n) - A_full

# 2 Partisi Sub-matriks dan Inversi Sektor Non-Lahan
idx_co <- co_idx
idx_nc <- no_idx
p_0_co <- as.numeric(LPC_0[idx_co])
M_nc_co <- M_full[idx_nc, idx_co, drop = FALSE]
M_nc_nc <- M_full[idx_nc, idx_nc, drop = FALSE]
M_nc_nc_inv <- solve(M_nc_nc) # Inversi khusus sub-matriks unconstrained
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# INPUT PARAMETER KHUSUS SKENARIO 2
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1. Ekstraksi Vektor LPC Baru
lpc_s2_vec <- as.numeric(sc_input$lpc_scenario$`LPC SKENARIO 2 (Rp Juta/Ha)`)[idx_valid]
lpc_s2_vec[is.na(lpc_s2_vec)] <- 0

# 2. Masukkan ke Vektor Sektor Lahan (p_0_co_s2)
p_0_co_s2 <- as.numeric(lpc_s2_vec[idx_co])

# Ambil LPC baru khusus sektor berbasis lahan (co)
p_0_co_s2 <- as.numeric(lpc_s2_vec[idx_co])

# Laju Pertumbuhan Non-Lahan Tetap BAU (Historis)
growth_rate_bau <- as.numeric(unlist(baseline$growth_rate))[idx_valid]
growth_rate_bau[is.na(growth_rate_bau)] <- 0
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FUNGSI PROYEKSI SKENARIO 2 MULTI-INDIKATOR
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
proyeksi_skenario2_multi <- function(area_matrix, P_matrix, Y_0, idx_co, idx_nc, 
                                     p_0_co,     # LPC Baseline (BAU)
                                     p_0_co_new, # LPC Target Baru Skenario 2
                                     M_nc_co, M_nc_nc_inv, A_full, v_c, w_c, l_c, sub_c, 
                                     growth_rate, initial_year, tahun) {
  t_max <- length(tahun)
  n <- length(v_c)
  m <- length(idx_co)
  
  # Penampung Matriks
  x_out <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = n)
  PDRB_sektoral <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = n)
  Inc_sektoral <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = n)
  Lab_sektoral <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = n)
  SUB_sektoral <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = n)
  L_co_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = m)
  FD_co_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = m)
  
  P_sub <- as.matrix(P_matrix[idx_co, , drop = FALSE])
  storage.mode(P_sub) <- "numeric"
  
  for (k in seq_len(t_max)) {
    yr <- tahun[k]
    selisih_tahun <- yr - initial_year
    
    # A. Permintaan Akhir Sektor Non-Lahan BAU
    Y_nc_t <- Y_0[idx_nc] * ((1 + growth_rate[idx_nc]) ^ selisih_tahun)
    
    # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # B. LOGIKA PENDEKATAN B: PENENTUAN LPC BERDASARKAN TAHUN
    # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    target_year <- tahun[t_max]
    
    if (yr == initial_year) {
      p_0_co_t <- p_0_co
    } else if (yr <= target_year) {
      prop <- (yr - initial_year) / (target_year - initial_year)
      p_0_co_t <- p_0_co + prop * (p_0_co_new - p_0_co)
    } else {
      p_0_co_t <- p_0_co_new
    }
    
    # Hitung Output Sektor Lahan
    luas_tutupan_t <- as.numeric(unlist(area_matrix[, k]))
    L_co_t <- as.vector(P_sub %*% luas_tutupan_t)
    x_co_t <- matrix(L_co_t * p_0_co_t, ncol = 1)
    
    # C. Solusi Simultana Mixed IO
    rhs <- Y_nc_t - (M_nc_co %*% x_co_t)
    x_nc_t <- M_nc_nc_inv %*% rhs
    
    # D. Rekonstruksi Output Total
    x_t <- numeric(n)
    x_t[idx_co] <- as.vector(x_co_t)
    x_t[idx_nc] <- as.vector(x_nc_t)
    
    # E. Net Ekspor Lahan (Final Demand Absorption)
    konsumsi_antara_co <- as.vector(A_full[idx_co, , drop = FALSE] %*% x_t)
    FD_co_t <- as.vector(x_co_t) - konsumsi_antara_co
    
    # F. Multi-Indikator Makroekonomi
    PDRB_sektoral[k, ] <- v_c * x_t
    Inc_sektoral[k, ]  <- w_c * x_t
    Lab_sektoral[k, ]  <- l_c * x_t
    SUB_sektoral[k, ]  <- sub_c * x_t
    
    x_out[k, ] <- x_t
    L_co_matrix[k, ] <- L_co_t
    FD_co_matrix[k, ] <- FD_co_t
  }
  
  list(
    x_t = x_out,
    L_co_matrix = L_co_matrix,
    FD_co_matrix = FD_co_matrix,
    PDRB_total = rowSums(PDRB_sektoral, na.rm = TRUE),
    Inc_total = rowSums(Inc_sektoral, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lab_total = rowSums(Lab_sektoral, na.rm = TRUE),
    SUB_total = rowSums(SUB_sektoral, na.rm = TRUE),
    Output_total = rowSums(x_out, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EKSEKUSI PROYEKSI SKENARIO
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
tahun <- as.numeric(colnames(area_matrix_bau))
initial_year <- 2025

proyeksi_s2 <- proyeksi_skenario2_multi(
  area_matrix = area_matrix_bau,
  P_matrix = P_default,
  Y_0 = Y_0,
  idx_co = idx_co,
  idx_nc = idx_nc,
  p_0_co = p_0_co,       
  p_0_co_new = p_0_co_s2, 
  M_nc_co = M_nc_co,
  M_nc_nc_inv = M_nc_nc_inv,
  A_full = A_full,
  v_c = v_c,
  w_c = w_c,
  l_c = l_c,
  sub_c = sub_c,
  growth_rate = growth_rate_bau,
  initial_year = 2025,
  tahun = tahun
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# REKAPITULASI & TABEL COMPARISON SKENARIO
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

df_proyeksi_s2 <- data.frame(
  Tahun = tahun,
  PDRB_Total_Juta = proyeksi_s2$PDRB_total,
  Pendapatan_TK_Juta = proyeksi_s2$Inc_total,
  Serapan_TK_Orang = round(proyeksi_s2$Lab_total, 0),
  Surplus_Usaha_Bruto_Juta = proyeksi_s2$SUB_total
)

print("--- REKAPITULASI HASIL PROYEKSI SKENARIO 2 ---")
print(df_proyeksi_s2)
```
